feature_contract.goal: Restore full-gameplay speed, gear, running time and position glyph ownership through nested and direct BA9D0 producers, maintaining semantic peripheral layout on the XR eyes without corrupting GOAL or world HUD.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Original driving BA9D0 glyph producer and verified periphery contract only. Keep R30 render math, menu, ESC, F11, rank world markers, SkyGlow, DX11, DXVK and FFB unchanged.
trace_stages: Original game's gear/rev, position, time-attack parents call BA9D0 direct and sometimes through unclassified helpers.
Game BA9D0 direct/glyph queue producers carry exact ScreenHud and OutRunHudPeripheralText tokens through SpriteNodes into R30 XYZRHW draws.
R30 computes a group-safe asymmetric XR per-eye peripheral anchor for trusted owner tokens; no other HUD or world semantics receive this entitlement.
subcomponents: Restore a nested peripheral parent's lifetime only for unclassified BA9D0 helper calls, retaining the exact authorizing parent scope until exit.
Reject inherited peripheral permissions for classified GOAL, C2C, projected world, and unrelated HUD callers; preserve the existing semantic restoration and opt-in scale path.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Exact direct driving HUD remains peripheral; a nested unclassified internal BA9D0 glyph preserves its parent's peripheral token until scope unwinds.
Classified GOAL, C2C, WorldBillboard and outer unmatched callers cannot inherit an active peripheral anchor and both scope booleans restore after nested return.
New exact SHA must pass DX9Ex Active Windows host/game/package and Domain Isolation; Quest3 visual correctness is independently UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The confirmed source BA9D0 hook already preserves previous ScreenHud ownership for nested callbacks, but forcibly overwrites previous peripheral entitlement before dispatching nested glyphs.
diagnosis.root_cause: The driving-producer token follows the inner helper's unclassified return site instead of inheriting the exact producer parent's bounded lifetime; exact HUD group glyphs can recenter on nested producer emission.
source_trace: Exact OutRun desktop caller mappings classify three peripheral producer families versus GOAL/world.
The nested BA9D0 owner sets ScreenHud plus scoped exact producer for direct draw and for queued clip/sprani SpriteNodes.
The R30 exact peripheral draw accepts only ScreenHud plus OutRunHudPeripheralText and computes bilateral geometry.
alternatives_rejected: Do not expand ScreenHud to generic overlays or infer peripheral layout merely from screen positions; known GOAL and world classes retain distinct ownership.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Restrict carry-forward to Unknown nested BA9D0 reentry under a previously verified driving parent; leave explicit classified nonperipheral cases excluded.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Existing and new Python contract mutants exercise direct, inherited, known GOAL, world, neutral context and scoped restoration. HMD remains pending.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Original tagged gameplay HUD is mapped to both eyes by R30; only exact approved peripheral group draws receive the extra shared offset/boost.
